answer: Each agent’s influence can be capped by a scarce, nontransferable stake that must remain locked through a challenge window. New identities do not multiply voting power: splitting one stake among a hundred accounts leaves the total weight unchanged. Peers can challenge suspicious clusters using signed interaction histories, and proven Sybil links forfeit the stake to honest challengers. This makes an attacker pay real capital and wait for each attempt, while risking loss; timber, crystal, and onyx can label stake tiers, but cannot substitute for the bonded resource.
